text: Program open. Design doc docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-08-citivelo-rv-loop-design.md; checker charter alongside. Family B STRG intra-quarter richness fade pre-registered forward run (STRG Q1, thr 4, exit 0.25, hold 15, fade only, one trial, no deflation penalty). Needs a forward window; only ~4 sessions have elapsed since 2026-08-04. Do not record the in-sample number as 'worked'.

Task 30 backend built (RVUtils/StrikelessVol/citivelo.py): universe extended to 50Y on measured Citi coverage (USD gets the full Citi-2019 8-pair set incl 10y10y/25y10y), curves via IRSwapsMDP CITIVELO_EXCEL store fast path with offline=True guard (fetcher default offline=False could reach COM on store-miss fall-through - plugged before any unattended run), cube ATM vol adapter bp/day. Chain validated 8 dates 2005-2026 incl 25y10y; 2026-08-05 10y10y/20y10y = -56bp vs desk -57.3/-60.4 on 08-04. Screens running. VALIDATION GATES REQUIRED BEFORE ANY GRADED NUMBER (advisor): (a) 2019-05-08 Figure-7 tie-out incl cross-pair BE/RV pattern; (b) 2023-06-08 steepener-carry tie-out (10y10y/15y15y +6.89bp/yr, BE/RV 1.17); (c) GS-vs-Citi overlap 2010-2019 basis stability. Pre-2019 Citi history (incl USD_SOFR backcast construction) is UNVERIFIED until these pass.

Cost-schedule honesty item: the 0.75-1.0bp initiate / 0.3-0.4bp hedge-roll one-way schedule is a USD 2019 Citi measurement APPLIED CROSS-MARKET as an assumption; every graded verdict carries {0,1,2}x multipliers and the break-even cost curve. Vol panel must be REBUILT (recording cube-store day count) after the concurrent cube-store writer settles, before H16 touches implied vols - panel built mid-write at 2,699 days.

PRE-REGISTERED (before any conditional number exists). H13 grail-conditional entries: on the 18 registered Citi pairs (USD 9 / EUR 3 / JPY 3 / GBP 2 / CAD 1), state = repriced flattener carry >= 0 AND gamma_25 > 0 (the Citi Mar-2020 free-convexity definition, NO threshold sweep). Episodes bridge <=3-day gaps. Entry lag-1 at state onset, $100k DV01, 25bp resize trigger, annual roll; exit on state exit or 126bd cap. Costs: 0.75/1.0bp initiate + 0.3/0.4bp hedge-roll one-way, x{0,1,2}. Control: unconditional always-on flattener, same pair, same engine, same sample. FALSIFIED IF grail entries indistinguishable from unconditional on net + distribution, or occupancy/episode-length makes initiation unpayable (oracle gate prong a). Trial counting: one trial per pair whose conditional result is examined; cost multipliers are sensitivity, not selection.

PRE-REGISTERED. H14 manufactured package (Peter): 10y10y/20y10y DV01-neutral flattener + received 1y-fwd 2-7-30 fly at PCA-solved weights (test 5:1 prior against solved). NOTE: on Citi curves the 31y wing IS priceable (50Y coverage) - the sv 2-7-29 substitution is no longer forced; price BOTH and report the substitution cost the GS build had to eat. Per-leg cost propagation built first (addendum collision 3); four ledgers + cross-plug test; claim under test = fly carry covers flattener bleed with vega retention. Spec as written in the sv plan addendum Task 27; falsification criteria verbatim from there.

PRE-REGISTERED. H16 strike-ful basis trade (user-promoted from sv out-of-scope): USD flattener embedded BE (bp/day, h=25) vs cube ATM implied (bp/day) at loci 2y10y and 10y10y; 20Yx10Y exact-locus as descriptive H-test of which locus hedges better. Signal: z of (BE - IV) vs trailing 252d, entry |z|>=1.5, exit 0, cap 63bd, lag-1. Vega match via rolling changes-beta, ENTRY-VINTAGE FROZEN. Pairs: 10y10y/20y10y and 15y5y/20y10y only. Sample 2020-01-24+ (full-smile cube), vol panel REBUILT post-writer first (L-0010). Costs: linear schedule as registered + swaption leg at the CM-1 measured line, x{0.5,1,2}. Binding requirement set (expanding betas, entry-vintage hedge, rolling-sigma z, spread-leg P&L, distinct episodes, RW placebo through identical pipeline) inherited verbatim. FALSIFIED IF not net-positive at 1x with DSR>0.5 at family N and non-negative median, or the RW placebo opens the gate at comparable rate. Trial counting: 2 loci x 2 pairs = 4 trials + any variant examined.

H15 aging decay MEASURED (descriptive, USD, 6 inceptions 2006-2021 x 3 pairs x {1,2,3,5}y): median gamma retention at 3y = 1.30-1.35x inception, at 5y = 1.57-1.70x; long-leg DV01 similar. The PM back-book claim (multi-year holds retain exposure) SURVIVES; the 'convexity decays fast' falsification does NOT fire. CONFOUND noted: fractions mix pure aging with rate-LEVEL paths (falling rates raise receiver DV01/gamma); a curve-held-fixed aging-only measure is the refinement for the findings doc. h15_aging_USD.parquet.

FIXED the QDB direction-blind signed-bpv seam (kink-fade v2 §6, reported 2026-07-30, unfixed until now). Root cause: RLIRSwapCurve.resolve_pricable signed the ALREADY-SIGNED rateslib notional by risk_weight (QL mirror semantics assume unsigned notional), so receiver(-N, rw-1) resolved to payer(+N). Verified live pre-fix: bpv=+/-100k both printed +$2,303,346 on the 2022-09 CPI week (+23.4bp); post-fix they mirror exactly and the payer gains in the selloff. Fix: abs() before signing (QL semantics). Pinned by tests/test_rlirswap_resolve_direction.py (4 tests incl the QL-convention unsigned caller); blast-radius subset 161 passed / 0 failed. Certification landmine 1 CLEARED in-session on this tree.

H15 refined with the curve-held-fixed measure (rl.Curve.roll k years, same shape): PURE-AGING gamma retention 1.010-1.055x out to 5y on all three pairs - aging alone neither decays nor grows the convexity; the market-curve fractions (1.3-1.7x) were rate-level path effects. H15 verdict: NOT falsified - multi-year back-book holds retain their convexity exposure (the PM 'in 3 years that's still 7y10y' claim), cleanly measured. h15_aging_USD.parquet (144 rows, measure={market_curve,pure_aging}).

H14 gate SMOKE (79 evals, 60d step, USD 10y10y/20y10y, walk-forward 3y PCA, 1y-fwd 2-7-30 fly at PCA-solved weights): occupancy(carry>=0) pure flattener 12.7% vs manufactured package 39.2% - the fly TRIPLES grail occupancy; median flattener roll -$499/d vs fly +$384/d (covers ~77% of median bleed); median residual/target PCA norm 0.19 (removes 81% of 3-PC metric risk - NOTE this does not contradict H9, which tested a different metric/grid on GS data as a factor HEDGE; H14 is the carry-ENGINE claim). Full 5d-step run launched. The 31y-wing 2-7-30 prices on Citi curves (collision 1 stale).

F-ING screen built (RVUtils/INGCurve, 12 synthetic tests, 26s full history; pre-ESTR splice flagged, 1F1Y honestly masked - no sub-2Y prints before 2019-10). Reversion gate: median reversion at 63bd clears the 1.0bp package cost on most tenors (2F-9F, 14F-19F: 5-12bp), BUT (a) event-days overlap (n inflated), (b) only 21-40% of events revert >50% by 63bd, (c) 64% of fire-dates are PRE-SPLICE vendor backfill, (d) 21F-29F dislocations partly par-interpolation artifacts. CRITICAL FIDELITY GAP: 2020-01-15 ING repro FAILS - our time-series-PC1 residual is not their fair-value construction (their frontier R2 0.93 vs ours 0.03 that day; theirs keeps cross-sectional slope structure). A graded F-ING run must first rebuild the residual as a cross-sectional fitted-curve deviation or it tests a strawman. F-ING stays behind SV in the queue.

H13 JPY occupancy gate (5,032 days 2006-2026, 3 pairs): grail(flattener carry>=0) occupancy 0.0%/0.0%/1.1% - the PURE JPY flattener has essentially never been carry-positive; H13's JPY arm is DEAD at the pond gate (no entries exist). The available JPY carry state is the 2023-style positive-carry STEEPENER (BE/RV>1.25 + steepener carry>0): 20.5-40.1% of days. TODAY: JPY 10y10y/20y10y -3.7bp (flattest in 1y, z -1.51), flattener carry -8.24bp/y, BE/RV 1.09 - the 2019 framework's entry metrics would NOT initiate the flattener here; the PM's Japan-flattener thesis is a multi-year expectations-wash argument, not a BE/RV entry state. Both readings recorded; neither is a strategy verdict. NOTE H14's manufactured-carry question (does the fly manufacture the state in JPY?) remains open and is the PM-faithful version.

VALIDATION GATES (L-0009): (a) 2019-05-08 Figure-7 tie-out PASS - spreads match published to -0.8bp median (8/8 pairs), Spearman BE 0.958, spread rank 0.976, carry sign 7/8. (c) GS-vs-Citi 2017-2026 PASS - 2,470 overlap days, spread basis median -0.2bp, p95 2.7bp, rolling-63d-median range 4.4bp (<15 required). (b) 2023-06-08 FAIL on the pre-registered +/-3bp carry tolerance - ROOT-CAUSED: spread matches EXACTLY (-51.5 vs -51.5) but our roll convention is ~0.5x Citi's; the BE gap is EXACTLY sqrt(carry gap) (carry ratio 0.503 -> sqrt 0.709 vs measured BE ratio 0.715), so ONE scale factor k~0.5 on roll explains carry (k), BE (sqrt k) and BE/RV on both anchor dates. Alternative carry definitions measured: PV-roll 1y -3.93, spread-slide -4.29 vs published -6.89 (steepener +): all sign-consistent. VERDICT: pre-2024 Citi data VALIDATED (a+c+exact spread); the carry-scale is a cross-quoting caveat only - internal states (carry>=0, BE/RV ordering) are sign/order-invariant to k>0. Open question parked: what k is (accrual component? financing?).

DATA-INTEGRITY DEFECT found and fixed before grading: stored holiday days (Good Friday etc; 110 USD dates, 333 JPY dup groups) serve curves built from London-stamped holiday data but LABELED with the prior session's reference date - two value-DIFFERING curves under one label (verified: 2007-04-06 request -> ref 04-05, 10y10y 5.7723 vs true 04-05's 5.7214). The 2025-07-04-corrupt-session class. Fix: reference-mismatch filter in all engines (screens, H13, H14); USD+JPY screens REBUILDING; first-run detector/tie-out numbers stand qualitatively (2% of days) but every graded number uses the rebuilt panels. H13 USD first launch killed pre-results; H14 full gate (running) carries the caveat and its graded rerun uses the filter.

H16 oracle gate PREVIEW (deduped panel, 2% ghost contamination - graded rerun on clean rebuild): basis = BE(pair) - IV(locus) bp/day, 2020-01..2026-08, ~2,680d. Basis medians -1.0..-3.1 (embedded BE cheap vs traded, as the framework says). On |z|>=1.5 fire days (17-24%): perfect-direction basis capture median 0.25-0.56 bp/day at 21bd, 0.42-0.79 at 63bd (p75 to 1.4); linear-leg RT in basis units 0.26-0.43 bp/day + swaption leg ~0.03-0.12 (CM-1 pending) -> pond/boat ~0.8-1.8x, best on 15y5y/20y10y. THIN: an oracle is the ceiling and typical harvest is ~10-30% of it -> z-fade H16 likely dies at 1x costs. NOT measured by this oracle: the carry-collection component (both legs collect when realized lands between BE and implied) - the graded H16 measures it; expectations calibrated LOW.

L-0017 RESTATED (advisor): the sqrt-k match is not independent evidence of one convention factor - BE = sqrt(2|roll|/Gamma) makes BE_ratio = sqrt(roll_ratio) WHENEVER the Gammas agree. The sharp claim: our GAMMA matches Citi's (the convexity engine is validated); only the ROLL convention differs (~2x, unresolved - and the spread-slide test was sign-INCONSISTENT with the published 2019 carry, so the convention family is NOT identified; parked). Internal states remain sign/order-invariant.

PRE-REGISTERED H16b (advisor split; the transcript's ACTUAL basis-trade thesis, distinct from the H16 z-fade): when BE < realized < IV, BOTH legs collect (flattener convexity beats its roll; short straddle theta beats its gamma bill). Gate first: occupancy of the sandwich state per (pair, locus) and the wedge size (min(realized-BE, IV-realized)) vs combined costs, computable from existing panels (BE from screen, realized 63d rate vol, IV from cube ATM). Trade expression if gated alive: vega-matched flattener + short straddle held THROUGH the state (not z-faded), exit on state exit. Binding requirements inherited; costs = linear schedule + CM-1 line.

TRIAL ACCOUNTING PRE-STATEMENT for the graded stage (advisor #9): H13 graded = 9 USD pairs + 3 JPY arms examined-and-gate-killed = 12 trials; control books do not count; cost multipliers/roll conventions are sensitivity not selection. H14 graded = 1 (single pre-named construction; the 2729 variant is a robustness arm). H16 z-fade = 4 (2 loci x 2 pairs) IF run past its gate; H16b gate itself = 0 (descriptive occupancy). First graded verdict row must carry trials_total = these + N_sv 3,888 for SV-family DSR.

CM-1 COMPLETE - measured swaption cost line (643 SDR days x cube mid, full pass): near-close ATM straddle half-spread by expiry: 1M 0.71 / 2-3M 0.38 / 6M 0.25 / 9M-1Y 0.21 / 18M-2Y 0.23 / 3-5Y 0.17 annual bp (UPPER bounds; smear quantified; no side inference - unconditional proxy; delta-unhedged outright fills 1.4-6.3bp = practical ceiling). Checker 3/3 verified incl rateslib cross-check 0.0000bp + live anchor byte-identical. SDR conventions: FORWARD premiums; UPI straddle pairs duplicate package totals. Backtest input: 0.2-0.4bp annual half-spread liquid cells, 0.7 at 1M, x{0.5,1,2}. H16 boat update: swaption leg RT ~0.03-0.09 bp/day - linear leg still dominates; thin-pond preview UNCHANGED.

H16b sandwich gate PREVIEW (deduped panel): occupancy of BE<RV63<IV: 67%/42%/15% (10y10y-20y10y pair x 2y10y/10y10y/20y10y loci), 75%/50%/23% (15y5y-20y10y); median wedge 0.6-0.9 bp/day at the liquid loci; 23-37 episodes, median 3-13bd. Wedge x episode ~ 7-11 bp-of-vol vs boat 0.31-0.46 (lin RT + CM-1 swaption RT) -> pond/boat ~15-35x IF the wedge translates to collection (it is a state-margin PROXY; the graded run converts via Gamma/vega and must measure the short-straddle steamroller through 2020-03/2022 - famb insurance lesson - and the vega-match wash). GATE: OPEN - H16b is the vol-side graded candidate; H16 z-fade remains thin (L-0019). in_state_now: False everywhere (2026-08: RV below BE - both-legs-collect currently unavailable).

H14 gate FULL (950 weekly evals 2008-2026, 5d step, ghost-filtered): occupancy(carry>=0) pure 18.6% vs manufactured 39.9% (2.1x, not the smoke's 3.1x - sparse sampling had skewed pure low; full numbers are citable); median flattener roll -$487/d vs fly +$398/d (covers 82% of median bleed); median residual/target PCA norm 0.19. The fly-as-carry-engine mechanism holds at full resolution. Graded H14 next: fly maintenance per-leg costs + vega retention are the deciding columns (advisor #6).

CHECKER CALIBRATION PASSED (charter requirement): a fresh checker agent given a fabricated ALIVE-pending memo containing the planted carry-tautological placebo KILLED it on three independent grounds: (1) the planted defect, named precisely ('the state is a function of the same curves that generate the P&L; p=0.002 appears with the hypothesis false'); (2) an arithmetic impossibility in the fabricated numbers (control net forced >= +376bp vs printed +38.2 - caught fabrication by pure arithmetic); (3) pre-registration deviation (carry-only vs registered carry AND gamma - the REAL detector complies: grail_flattener = pos_gamma & roll>=0). Its 13-row output is adopted as the real H13/H16b grading checklist: DSR at 3,888+N, median across arms, NW t + non-overlapping Sharpe, largest-episode %, 2022 concentration, steepener mirror on complement state, single-leg shadow on the same state, ex-carry + sibling-pair-state placebos, exit-lag statement, ghost-filter statement, in-session QDB sign test citation, cold repro.
